origin_frozen.source: Scacco et al. 2026, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.21915776, Data.zip MD5 e1f116e6576cf20e54dad16d2c91a26d

question: Does a focal bird's unique thermal-state-conditioned altitude shape improve held-out predictability beyond a population-wide SAME-SPECIES Wstar shape change applied to that bird's own pooled altitude profile?

model_comparison.unit: Biological bird within original source study×species; whole independent UTC day held out.
model_comparison.grain: 50km EPSG6933 cells; each day's profile median-centered and smoothed into unchanged ten bins.
model_comparison.target: same native GPS height fixes scored in both predictions, source birds fixed before altitude quality.
model_comparison.individual_wstar: P(z_center | bird,50km cell,Wstar low/high) trained on focal other UTC days, Jeffreys .5 per height category, average donor daily smoothed probability vectors equally.

shared_response.bird_baseline: P(z_center | focal bird,50km cell) trained on focal other UTC days, wind pooled.
shared_response.other_bird_wstar: P(z_center | OTHER biological birds, study×species,50km cell,same YYYY-MM, Wstar state), ALL other birds and ALL other UTC dates, excluding target day's entire flock.
shared_response.other_bird_pooled: P(z_center | OTHER biological birds, same cell and month, ALL Wstar regimes), excluding target day's entire flock.
shared_response.prediction_formula: q_shared(z) proportional to p_focal_pooled(z) × p_other_birds_wstar(z) / p_other_birds_pooled(z); renormalize across ten categories.
shared_response.weighting: Each other bird equally weighted within Wstar-state and pooled group, each eligible donor UTC day equally weighted within that bird.
shared_response.exclusion: Leave out the focal bird entirely and every other bird's observations on the target date to prevent contemporaneous shared weather/route leakage.
shared_response.smoothing: Same Jeffreys 0.5/bin day-level distribution as focal model; ratio bounded only by strictly positive smoothed probabilities, no data-specific clipping.

model_comparison.sufficient_population_response_gate: At least 2 distinct other biological birds and 10 native valid selected events in BOTH low and high Wstar contexts among OTHER dates and same calendar YYYY-MM of target; the pooled population reference uses the same donor restrictions. Do not switch months or spatial grids to rescue.
model_comparison.focal_donor_gate: At least10 focal own other-day fix events in target state, >=10 focal other-day opposite-state fixes in cell, and ≥10 other bird other-date fixes in cell.
model_comparison.day_gate: For a target bird-UTC-day, ≥20 selected 5-min events must score under BOTH models. At least 2 separate low and 2 separate high target days per biological bird; ≥10 birds per source panel.
model_comparison.score: Per matched target fix log P_individualWstar(z) minus log Q_sharedWstar(z); equal day weights within low/high, equal wind states per bird, equal birds.
model_comparison.interpretation: Positive held-out gain is an additional individual×Wstar predictive pattern conditional on assumed multiplicative common response; not an identified behavioral reaction or causal wind mechanism.

calibration.null: 999 permutations of entire low/middle/high bird-day Wstar state labels independently WITHIN each individual×YYYY-MM. Each permutation updates BOTH individual-wstar and shared species Wstar donor distributions and admissible bird support.
calibration.holm: All 4 fixed original study×species panels; unavailable panels always contribute p=1. Even significant exploratory p after Holm is NONCONFIRMATORY because new model was invented after observing 4-panel outcomes.
calibration.stop: If source/score/new common-response donor coverage lacks support, report unavailable and stop. Do not relax minimum birds, same-month, same-grid, thermal thresholds, selected species or height bins.
calibration.diagnostic: Report source 2016/17, original 4-panel supported/unavailable categories unchanged. No new generality claims without independent target.

causal_and_data_limits: One source includes original 38-taxon GPS and derived flapping/cost of transport; this new diagnostic is NOT a new species/source replication.
Other-bird shared response at 50km and month may contain different fine 5km topographic routes, GPS instrumentation, and social flock effects.
Pointwise ERA5 Wstar depends on locations selected by animals and cannot establish thermals encountered or adaptation.
Temporal autocorrelation and tag-associated GPS altitude errors remain; day median removes additive bias, not conditional error.
The Gyps africanus parent study failed 950/999 valid null earlier; do not reclassify original as supported based on exploratory diagnostic.
